note: The kb-shape gate's ratchets (tools/src/gates/check-kb-shape.ts and tools/src/kb/validate.ts read it through tools/src/lib/ratchet.ts; nothing generates from it). Three rules may be excused on a named page while its rewrite is pending, each an entry's `covers`: `explain` (a missing example or a word bound on the explain paragraph, KB-014), `costs` (a pattern's missing costs list, KB-014) and `description` (a description block over 80 words or in several paragraphs, KB-015; `maxWords` is the page's length when listed, and a page that grows past it fails). Nothing else is excusable. A new page is never listed. Delete an entry once its page passes without it, since the gate fails an entry that excuses nothing. An entry is { name, match, covers, reason, owner, since }: match is an exact path or a whole-path glob. Edit this file, then run: make gate G=check-kb-shape.
